title: Boundary Runway Tiling and Threshold Playbook
content:
Purpose:
This is a working playbook to manage short-window launches where rate/cost/loss contours change fast (pilot windows, partner pilots, low-latency features). The core idea is runway tiling: split the launch runway into discrete tiles (time + traffic buckets) with explicit KPI thresholds and runbook actions per tile.

Status and intent:
- Draft v0.9 for internal review.
- Goal: provide a codified decision thermostat so PM/Eng/Op teams can make quick go/no-go or throttle decisions without an ad-hoc incident call.
- Notes to self: validate P95 latency thresholds with serving-runtime team before finalizing.

Quick overview of approach:
1) Tile the runway: define tiles by time (hours/days) + expected traffic bands (0-1k rps, 1k-5k rps, 5k+ rps). Each tile has: target KPIs, alert thresholds, owner, and primary contingency.
2) Thermostat rules: if any critical KPI exceeds its threshold for >3 minutes in a tile, trigger the tile-level action (throttle, model fallback, rollback, engage incident).
3) Escalation ladder: tile owner -> product ops lead -> eng oncall -> SRE commander.

Tile structure (example):
- Tile A: Onboarding (0-6h), Traffic 0-500rps
  - Owner: Product Launch PM (Liam)
  - Targets: P50 latency < 120ms, P95 latency < 350ms, Error rate < 0.5%, Model quality pass rate >= 98% on eval set, Cost per 1k tokens < $6
  - Alert thresholds: P95 > 500ms, Error rate > 1.5%, Model eval drop >= 3pp
  - Actions: pause partner invites; enable KV cache warm-up; increase routing to Dedicated if available; run quick eval set and notify QA.

- Tile B: Scale-up (6-48h), Traffic 500-3k rps
  - Owner: SRE/Infra lead (Jia)
  - Targets: P50 < 140ms, P95 < 420ms, Error rate < 1.0%, Quality >= 97%
  - Alert thresholds: sustained P95 > 600ms for 5m, error rate spike > 2% for 3m
  - Actions: enable batching up to X ms, decrease max sequence length via routing policy for non-critical routes, fall back to smaller model variant for non-priority traffic, open ops channel and start cadence 15m updates.

- Tile C: Wide-open (48h+), Traffic >3k rps
  - Owner: Platform Eng (Noah)
  - Targets: P50 < 180ms, P95 < 500ms, Error rate < 1.5%, Cost per 1k tokens within committed budget
  - Alert thresholds: P95 > 750ms, Slo burn > 20% in 1h, error rate cluster affecting >10% of routes
  - Actions: progressive traffic shaping by cohort, enable additional Dedicated capacity (pre-agreed), roll back recent model/quantization changes, engage customer success for impacted customers.

Decision thermostat rules (operational):
- Minor alert: Any non-critical KPI crosses alert threshold but not critical threshold -> tile owner runs mitigation checklist, logs events, and monitors 30m.
- Major alert: Any critical KPI crosses critical threshold for >3m -> immediate execution of tile action, notify cross-functional incident thread, schedule review within 60m.
- Escalation: if actions do not reduce KPI below threshold within 30m -> escalate one level.

Owner playbook (what each owner must have ready):
- Pre-launch: checklist completed and accessible (links to infra runbooks, RBAC, current capacity map).
- During tile: 15m status updates (tile owner), snapshot metrics to snapshot repo, maintain a concise incident log (what changed, who ran which action).
- Post-tile: submit runway retrospec: what worked, tile thresholds tuning suggestions, cost delta, and recommended model config changes.

KPIs and suggested thresholds (configurable per product):
- Latency (P50/P95/P99) in ms (route-level and token-level)
- Error rate (5xx and inference errors) as percentage
- Model quality evaluation pass rate on canonical prompt set (percent)
- SLO burn: % of SLO consumed in last rolling hour
- Cost per 1k tokens (USD) by route
- Customer-facing metric: conversion/dropoff within first 3 interactions

Sample KPI tile table (ascii):
| KPI                        | Target        | Alert threshold | Critical threshold | Owner  |
|---------------------------|---------------|-----------------|--------------------|--------|
| P95 latency (overall)     | <350ms        | 500ms           | 600ms              | Tile A |
| Error rate                | <0.5%         | 1.5%            | 2.5%               | Tile A |
| Model eval pass rate      | >=98%         | 95%             | 92%                | QA     |
| Cost / 1k tokens          | <$6           | $8              | $12                | Finance|

Checklist snippets (pre-launch):
- Confirm model pin/version and trained eval set (owner: PM)
- Capacity snapshot and committed Dedicated pool check (owner: Infra)
- Run synthetic traffic test up to 120% anticipated peak and validate thermostat triggers (owner: SRE)
- Approve rollback image and canary routing policy (owner: Release Eng)
- Stakeholder signoff (PM, Product Ops, SRE, CS)

During-launch quick actions (operational guide):
- If P95 spikes: check host-level saturation, KV cache hit rate, and batch backlog. If host saturation -> increase Dedicated pool, else enable aggressive batching for low-priority routes.
- If model quality drop: pause new signups/invites, route critical customers to previous model variant, open QA-run eval set, mark PR to rollback if drop > 4pp.
- If cost overrun (projected): throttle non-critical routes by X% and open cost cadence with finance.

Contingency playbook (minimal steps):
1) Immediate: notify exec channel, mark tile degraded, enable fallback routing, open incident doc.
2) 5–15m: execute model fallback or capacity increase depending on root cause.
3) 15–60m: if unresolved, launch rollback to last-known-good deployment and enact controlled slowdown of feature.
4) Post: full RCA and KPI recalibration for next launch window.

Open questions / To validate before final: 
- Should we use 3m or 5m sustained windows for critical threshold detection? (SRE preference vs product tolerance)
- Exact cost delta tolerance per tile that triggers auto-throttle (input needed from finance).
- Owner contact matrix needs to include direct-alert phone numbers for exec-level escalations.

References and quick links (work-in-progress):
- Confluence draft: PRODOPS/boundary-tiling (linked_artifacts)
- Jira: PRODOPS-398 (ticket tracking thermal thresholds)
- Slack channel: #prodops-launch for live playbook execution

Immediate next steps (for this doc):
- (Asha) get SRE input on 3m vs 5m detection window by 2026-03-12
- (Jia) collect realistic P95 baselines per route and attach snapshot by 2026-03-15
- (Liam) align PMs on tile definitions and run a tabletop drill 2026-03-18

Notes to reviewers: please comment inline where thresholds look aggressive or where a missing mitigation exists. This is intended to be operational-first — keep examples small and prescriptive rather than theoretical.

Revision log (brief):
- v0.1 2026-02-18 initial concept and tile draft
- v0.5 2026-02-24 added thermostat rules and owner ladder
- v0.9 2026-03-10 updated thresholds after infra sync (awaiting SRE window decision)

End of doc.
